label: ABC4D_oC28_63_a_c_fg_c-001
title: $\beta$'-LiFePO$_{4}$ Structure
comments:
This is a high pressure phase. At some point below the experimental pressure of 6.5GPa it transforms into the ground state, $\beta$-LiMPO$_{4}$, which has the \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC4D_oP28_62_c_a_2cd_c-001}{monticellite (CaMgSiO$_{4}$) structure}. 
 This is a the quaternary form of \href{current_web_home_dir/AB2C4_oC28_63_c_ac_fg-001}{Na$_{2}$CrO$_{4}$ ($H1_{8}$)}.
